packageRules.description: Always the latest stable version; CI on JDK 27 is the gate
The JDK in the workflows is the baseline (27) and is raised by hand, together with java.version in the root POM and the image.
Held versions: each of these moves to the latest stable in the pull request that revises the code written for it (see .claude/CLAUDE.md, Held versions). Remove an entry here in that pull request.
Maven bumps through the wrapper: Renovate does not update distributionSha256Sum, so CI fails until it is set by hand (see .claude/CLAUDE.md, Maven Wrapper)
prBodyNotes: Update `distributionSha256Sum` in `.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties` to the SHA-256 of the new `apache-maven-<version>-bin.zip`, after checking the zip against Maven's published `.sha512`.
